discovery.Screener

Class to get data from screen function.

Available as lseg.data.discovery.Screener.

Syntax

Screener(expression)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
expression Yes screen expression

Properties

Property Description
expression Expression used to request the universe, e.g. 'peers(VOD.L)' for Peers or 'screen(...)' for Screener.

Example

screener = Screener('U(IN(Equity(active,public,primary))/*UNV:Public*/), IN(TR.HQCountryCode,"AR"), IN(TR.GICSIndustryCode,"401010")')
print(list(screener))
